source: RRB Group D (Level 1) CEN syllabus as published in the Railway Recruitment Board notices (rrbapply.gov.in and regional RRB sites)
intro: A single CBT of four subjects, set at roughly Class 10 level. General science is the subject that makes Group D different from the other railway exams, so give it a fixed share of your time.
note: After the CBT there is a physical efficiency test and then document verification and medical examination. These are not part of the written syllabus.

sections.name: Mathematics
topics: Number system, BODMAS, decimals and fractions, LCM and HCF
Simple and compound interest, profit and loss
Time and work, time and distance, pipes and cisterns
Elementary statistics, square roots, age calculations, calendar and clock

sections.name: General Intelligence and Reasoning
topics: Alphabetical and number series, coding and decoding
Syllogism, Venn diagrams, statement and conclusions, statement and assumptions
Jumbling, data interpretation and sufficiency, analytical reasoning, decision making

sections.name: General Science
topics: Physics: motion, force, work and energy, light, sound, electricity, magnetism, heat
Chemistry: matter, atoms and molecules, acids, bases and salts, metals and non-metals, carbon compounds, everyday chemistry
Life science: cells, tissues, human body systems, nutrition, diseases, plants, reproduction, ecology
Level of the questions is Class 10 CBSE standard
sections.tip: Most questions test one fact or one definition. The Class 8 to 10 NCERT science books are enough for this section.

sections.name: General Awareness and Current Affairs
topics: Current affairs: science and technology, sports, culture, personalities, economics, politics
Static GK: history, geography, polity, awards, firsts and national symbols
